CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial.enforce_account_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status <> OLD.status AND NOT (
   (OLD.status = 'draft' AND NEW.status IN ('active','closed')) OR
   (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status IN ('suspended','closed')) OR
   (OLD.status = 'suspended' AND NEW.status IN ('active','closed'))
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid commercial account status transition' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial.enforce_control_user_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.status <> OLD.status AND NOT (
   (OLD.status = 'pending_verification' AND NEW.status IN ('active','disabled')) OR
   (OLD.status = 'active' AND NEW.status IN ('suspended','disabled')) OR
   (OLD.status = 'suspended' AND NEW.status IN ('active','disabled'))
 ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid control user status transition' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation'; END IF;
 IF NEW.email_normalized <> OLD.email_normalized AND OLD.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT (current_setting('app.privacy_lifecycle', true) = 'on'
      AND NEW.status = 'disabled' AND NEW.email_normalized = 'erased-' || NEW.id::text || '@privacy.invalid') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'verified email identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION commercial.enforce_external_compensation_attestation_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'external compensation evidence is append-only' USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
 END IF;
 IF OLD.status <> 'proposed' OR NEW.status NOT IN ('approved','rejected')
  OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id OR NEW.plan_change_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.plan_change_id
  OR NEW.payment_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payment_id OR NEW.amount_minor IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.amount_minor
  OR NEW.currency IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.currency
  OR NEW.external_transaction_reference IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.external_transaction_reference
  OR NEW.document_reference IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.document_reference
  OR NEW.document_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.document_sha256
  OR NEW.proposed_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.proposed_by OR NEW.proposed_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.proposed_at THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'external compensation evidence cannot be rewritten' USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
